title: Meta says it has caught up with Anthropic and OpenAI with Muse Spark 1.3, its most powerful AI model yet
summary: Meta says it has caught up with Anthropic and OpenAI with Muse Spark 1.3, its most powerful AI model yet SiliconANGLE
body: Meta says it has caught up with Anthropic and OpenAI with Muse Spark 1.3, its most powerful AI model yet SiliconANGLE
summaryZh: Meta正式发布了其迄今为止最强大的AI大模型Muse Spark 1.3，官方宣称该模型在性能上已经追平了Anthropic和OpenAI的顶尖水平，凸显了当前大模型竞争的白热化和头部格局的变化。原始信息显示：Meta says it has caught up with Anthropic and OpenAI with Muse Spark 1.3, its most powerful AI model yet SiliconANGLE。该消息由SiliconANGLE发布，主题为“Meta says it has caught up with Anthropic and OpenAI with Muse Spark 1.3, its most powerful AI model yet”。其重要性主要体现在：Meta发布Muse Spark 1.3，标志着其在大模型领域追赶上行业领先者。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
